say:1:1013113001:1.text: Here, here! This box is super suspicious.
say:1:1013113001:1.source_cn: 呼……主人，就是这里！这个箱子，非常不对劲——
say:1:1013113001:1.male: Here, here! This box is super suspicious.
say:1:1013113001:1.female: Here, here! This box is super suspicious.

say:3:1013113002:0.text: Hey there, interested in this special box?
say:3:1013113002:0.source_cn: 哟，这位贵客！对这箱珍贵的宝物有兴趣吗？
say:3:1013113002:0.male: Hey there, interested in this special box?
say:3:1013113002:0.female: Hey there, interested in this special box?

say:4:1013113003:0.text: What makes this box so special?
say:4:1013113003:0.source_cn: 珍贵的宝物？总觉得这个形容背后有阴谋……
say:4:1013113003:0.male: What makes this box so special?
say:4:1013113003:0.female: What makes this box so special?

say:5:1013113004:0.text: Don't be mistaken, there's more than meets the eye!
say:5:1013113004:0.source_cn: 怎么会呢？贵客您有所不知，这箱东……宝物的来头可不简单！
say:5:1013113004:0.male: Don't be mistaken, there's more than meets the eye!
say:5:1013113004:0.female: Don't be mistaken, there's more than meets the eye!
